_readme: This file is a template, not a working SeedVR2 graph. class_type values that start with REPLACE_ are rejected before any prompt is sent. Export your own ComfyUI API-format workflow and point config.yaml at it. See workflows/README.md. Node 4 lists the SeedVR2VideoUpscaler input names verified from numz/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler so you can rename that one class_type after comfy-info shows it is installed. Loader and saver class types are not filled in: those nodes are not part of SeedVR2 and must be copied from your export. uniform_batch_size must stay false. Do not point the image input at the alpha or source_rgba folders.

1._comment: Load the RGB PNG directory only. Rename inputs.directory to that node's real field.

2._comment: Verified class_type to check for: SeedVR2LoadDiTModel. Required inputs include model and device, which depend on your install, so they are left for your API export.

3._comment: Verified class_type to check for: SeedVR2LoadVAEModel. Required inputs include model and device.

4._comment: Verified class_type to check for: SeedVR2VideoUpscaler. resolution is the shortest edge in pixels, not a scale factor. batch_size on that node must be 4n+1 and at least 5 (5, 9, 13, ...). temporal_overlap is optional; this tool writes --temporal-overlap only when the live node or this workflow already has that input.

5._comment: Write PNGs whose sorted names match frame order. Rename inputs.output_path to that node's real field. Do not pad the frame count.
